hooks.command: "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready push --hook; loom_hook_exit_code=$?; if [ "$loom_hook_exit_code" -eq 86 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"loom: publication hook failed (checker runtime unavailable; run loom-python --repair in an agent station); allowing."}\n'; exit 0; fi; exit "$loom_hook_exit_code"

if python3 -c 'import json,sys; assert sys.version_info >= (3,7)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/language-anchor.py"; fi; "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready --script ../hooks/language-anchor.py; loom_hook_exit_code=$?; if [ "$loom_hook_exit_code" -eq 86 ]; then exec python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/language-anchor.py"; fi; exit "$loom_hook_exit_code"
